products.name: AIVA
products.note: Classical music AI composer; copyright assignment; EU-hosted; commercial licensing

profile_text.body:
AIVA Technologies operates the AI music generation platform AIVA, which the company describes as an AI music generation assistant capable of producing original songs across more than 250 different styles within seconds. The service is positioned for a broad range of users, from complete beginners to experienced music producers, and is built on generative AI technology.

The held facts note that AIVA falls within the voice and audio product category, is EU-hosted, and involves copyright assignment alongside commercial licensing arrangements, which are relevant considerations for users intending to use generated music professionally. No litigation, SEC filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company at this time.
